name: jev-cascade calibration set
purpose: freeze the Glue-2 / Glue-3 confidence thresholds once (PREDECLARATION.md); not for reporting
format: jev-style eval labelled JSONL (one /v1/systemone request per line + 'label' per question); row-level 'meta' is not sent to engines; first line is a '#' comment (skipped by load_rows)

dedup.checked: exact: state (whole, normalized), item-specific instructions, criteria texts >= 32 chars, raw source text fields >= 32 normalized chars; template instructions (shared by >= 3 candidates) are only logged. near-duplicate: share of the state's 13-word shingles found in any DI suite state/instruction or JevBench public item >= threshold
